definitions.full: H7236. rebah רְבָה verb grow great ( ᵑ7 Syriac; see Biblical Hebrew I. רבה ); — Pe`al Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ר Dan 4:8 +; 3 feminine singular רְבָת 4:19 ; 2 masculine singular רְבַיְתָ Kt ( > רְבַת Qr K § 47, Beisp. 1 ) a )) 4:19 ; — grow tall and large , of tree 4:8 ; 4:17 ; grow long , of hair 4:30 ; figurative grow great , of king 4:19 , increase , of greatness 4:19 . Pa`el make great: Perfect 3masculine singular רַבִּי Dan 2:48 with ל accusative of person
